common_assumptions: File paths are valid and content is current without pre-read verification
Type-check or noEmit passes constitute runtime validation
Single-step response is sufficient for style enforcement tasks regardless of content complexity
Tool output represents complete untruncated state
Prior session context and file contents are unchanged between tool calls
strength_patterns: Deep multi-step chains use diverse tool types reflecting genuine investigation before reporting completion
Sequential dependency ordering is respected — reads precede writes and verification follows edits
Iterative grep-then-read patterns in long chains narrow scope before acting rather than operating on assumptions
weakness_patterns: Bimodal depth distribution (42 of 63 chains at depth 1) indicates most tasks receive no reasoning depth at all
Repetitive reads of the same file within 68–135 step chains indicate fixation loops rather than progressive exploration
tsc --noEmit and collect-only verification used in lieu of runtime exercise in multi-step implementation chains
